incident: both followers stalled on the coordinator (EURUSD crash loop exit 1; ETH stuck in phase 3)

root_causes.cause: DuckDB 1.5.6 ART primary-key index kept a phantom row_identity_sha256 (205c2e80..., also cccb72a0...) after the follower had been SIGKILLed mid-transaction; SELECT found no row, INSERT raised Duplicate key; CHECKPOINT does not clear it; the follower let the engine exception escape and exited 1 every pass (189 restarts)
root_causes.evidence: logs/follow_eurusd.log tracebacks; repair experiment on a copy: baseline FAIL, after CHECKPOINT FAIL, single-row insert FAIL with 0 matching rows, after table rebuild OK (26,136 rows inserted)

root_causes.cause: phase-3 terminals were digested with integer K keys in methods[*].subsets; after the JSON write/read cycle the keys are strings and sort differently, so terminal_sha256 never verified and close_phase3 reported 'terminal corrupt' on every pass (the ETH follower itself did not crash-loop; its last exit before the intervention was rc=143 from the operator stop)
root_causes.evidence: recomputed digest of eth/phase3/terminals/*.json.gz equals the JSON-round-trip digest, not the stored one

fix: canonical_bytes digests the JSON form (keys stringified before sorting); phase-3 subsets keyed by str(K)
follow_once isolates a per-unit submission exception into submit_failures/<unit>.json and continues; follow() never crash-loops on a failed pass and finishes the unit in flight on SIGTERM
run_phase3 quarantines and recomputes a phase-3 terminal whose digest does not verify

tools/fs_phase23_deploy/rebuild_duckdb_pk_index.py rebuilds the PK index with count/digest parity; applied to both population stores with followers stopped (PK_INDEX_REBUILD_*.json); the DATA agent had independently rebuilt the EURUSD store at 08:54:21Z (warehouse/INDEX_REBUILD_20261006T085421Z.json)
regression_tests: 4 added; 25 passing with the campaign venv (tools/test_fs_phase23_driver.py, tools/fs_phase23_deploy/test_register_run.py)
